statement: Launch one full-window kinetic pilot at 384^2, ppc=32/species, mass ratio 25, Ti/Te=1, vA/c=.01, di=measured delta from fresh 256^2 state; absorbing patch half-size .3, fixed origin ROI half extents (.04,.015), primary 4^2 and secondary 8^2 bins, tOmega .4-.9 after .4 initialization allowance, explicit Yee CFL .7. Quantify noise/heating and full cost before final selection. Enlarge patch to .4 at same dx and ROI to test field-boundary influence; particle-origin tag separately diagnoses transit. Geometric light-travel clearance alone cannot qualify the window.

alternatives.affordable and stable: Complete .9 with stable energy and resolvable pressure bins
alternatives.numerically limited: Grid heating, transient or boundary differences exceed observable tolerance
